name: Customer.io

credentials.name: app_api_key
credentials.label: App API key
credentials.help: In Customer.io open Account settings, API credentials, App API keys, and create a key. Customer.io App API keys are not scoped, so treat it as full access. This connector only sends GET requests to the campaign and newsletter lists, never to people. Create the key with read-only scope where the provider offers it, so this connection can read your data but never change it.

params.name: region
params.label: API host: api for US accounts, api-eu for EU accounts

notes: Campaign and newsletter settings: id, name, state, type, tags, dates. No people, segments or delivery logs are loaded. Customer.io's per-campaign metrics are a separate call per campaign and are not loaded yet. created_by and updated_by name a teammate and are removed.
